resources.string: Configure declared accelerator settings. These values do not verify installed hardware, compatibility, capacity or an inference runtime.
device_count · required integer count, at least 1. No default is added.
tensor_parallel_groups · optional integer count, at least 1 when supplied. No relationship to device count is inferred.
Enter an integer value. An empty supplied value cannot be saved.
Use a complete exact JSON integer value. Fractions, locale separators and unknown values cannot be saved.
This value exceeds the supported input representation. Shorten it before saving.
